notes.title: Chromatic Isle Patch - Version 1.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Chromatic Isle Version 1.3 Patch Notes[/h2]
Hey everyone! I'm pretty sure very few people will read this, but I've released a small path for Chromatic Isle featuring some QoL fixes for you based off of the feedback I've received. If you have any more issues to report please let me know! I'm working on this game in my free time and will fix what I can, thanks! 
~ Josh

[h3]Changes, Bugfixes, and QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue for some users in which audio would not play through the entire game (nightmare nightmare nightmare)
[*] Fixed bug for some users where pressing F12 would reset the game instead of taking a screenshot (also nightmare nightmare nightmare)
[*] Improved load times on lower end machines (just don't try to run it on your phone lol)
[*] Fixed bug on some HDR displays where brightness could be set to maximum
[*] Fixed bug for some systems which experienced audio-delay
[*] Fixed issue with lighting in Winter area not rendering properly
[*] Fixed issue with some grass not appearing
[*] Fixed issue for some users where audio desyncs in Winter puzzle
[*] Fixed bug where if your framerate was too high, you could frame-perfect backwards wall jump out of the map and soft lock yourself (you're all insane)
[*] Removed debug "run super fast" mode from being accessible via client-only
[*] Fixed issue for some users in which the game would not pause when the Steam Overlay was enabled
[*] Injected extra vibes into the atmosphere
[*] Made one sign in the hub more glowy-er
[*] The game now likes it when you spend time with your pets
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grass in the Spring and Fall areas occasionally responds to ambient occlusion incorrectly
[*] Some trees in the Spring area have small glowing spots on them
[*] One of the Winter Puzzle solutions is inconsistent for some users
[*] Mouse DPI sensitivity settings are inconsistent for some users (but still adjustable and playable)
[*] Solution sound visualizer orbs do not have hitboxes for some players
[/list]

Thanks everyone, I hope you continue to enjoy the game. We're past 1,200 players and I've gained a lot of feedback about the project. I appreciate everyone who has purchased the soundtrack as well and continued to support the game. Please enjoy these fixes - thanks!

notes.title: Chromatic Isle Soundtrack Released as DLC
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you.[/h1]
After an incredible amount of positive reception for my small puzzle game - I could not be more thankful. Even as a free game, it warms my heart that so many people have enjoyed Chromatic Isle. As of writing this, more than 750 people have played the game. That's far more than I could have ever anticipated. I want to thank all of you (the players!) for having such a good time with it. I hope you enjoyed playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

With all of these playthroughs I've received a lot of feedback. Many of you have been kind enough to tell me what you like and dislike about the game, but more than anything people have asked for "more." While I am considering making a longer, more fleshed out sequel, that's not something I can do at the moment.

So in the mean time, I've decided to release the soundtrack for $1. This way you can get a taste of some of the ideas I worked with, and a sneak peek into some unused bonus tracks. The soundtrack can be purchased as DLC through Steam, and the files are DRM free so you can move them to any of your devices. I've kept the game free, but if you'd like to support further development, feel free to pick the soundtrack up.

Above all, I am more than happy with such a warm reception of my little game, and it has filled me with determination to pursue a larger sequel. According to Steam, every day 12 new people download and play the game - that's incredible to me. I'm so elated to share this experience with you all. Thank you all so much. 

[h3]~ Josh[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686220/Chromatic_Isle_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Chromatic Isle is now out on Steam for free!
notes.notes:
[h1]Chromatic Isle is now out for free![/h1]
Thank you to everyone who supported me along the way! I'm so excited to share this experience with all of you. I hope you all enjoy the game as much as I have enjoyed making it. If you have any thoughts, feedback, bugs, or anything else to say, please feel free to post in the Steam Community. 

[h2]What is Chromatic Isle?[/h2]
Embark on a serene journey through the musical realms of Chromatic Isle, a short 30-minute low-poly 3D puzzle game intended to be completed in one sitting. Explore four distinct areas, each themed around a different season and offering a unique music-focused puzzle. Unwind and let the music guide your way.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2684780/extras/Chromatic_Isle_Seasons_Gif.gif?t=1705327435[/img]

[h3]Puzzles Focused on Sound and Music[/h3]
The puzzles of Chromatic Isle focus entirely on exploring different aspects of sound and music. Discover small musical abilities you never knew you had as you encounter each of the four serene areas.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2684780/extras/Chromatic_Isle_Puzzles_Gif.gif?t=1705327435[/img]

[h3]Non-linear Design[/h3]
Chromatic Isle has been built for you to explore in your own order, at your own pace. Take your time and enjoy what the isle has to offer.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2684780/extras/Chromatic_Isle_NonLinear_Gif.gif?t=1705327435[/img]
